# Leave Policy

## Paid Time Off

### Vacation

Everyone at Example Co gets 18 days of paid vacation each year, plus the public holidays of their country. Please record each day off in the team calendar.

### Sick Days

We do not keep a sick-day balance. Tell your lead as soon as you know you will be out, and say roughly for how long.

If you are away for more than five working days in a row, we move you onto medical leave and ask for a doctor's note.

## Your First Month

Welcome aboard. During your first month you will pair with a buddy who answers questions about tools and process.

Your lead will meet you every week to agree on goals for the month.

## Sabbatical

Every three years you may take a 30-day paid sabbatical. Give your team three months of notice so they can plan around it.

## Leaving the Company

If your contract ends, you may receive a severance payment of four weeks of pay, plus two more weeks for each full year you worked here.
